name: Semiconductor Device Technology
description: Semiconductor materials, semiconductor growth/purification, crystal structure / defects, doping, diffusion, unit processes in device fabrication, including oxidation, ion implantation, rapid thermal processing, optical lithography, cleanroom basics, vacuum systems, plasma processes, etching - chemical and physical, gas chemistry, physical vapor deposition, chemical vapor deposition (CVD), MOCVD, MBE/ALD, planarization and process integration, device yield, introduction to device and system level packaging.
